683:t_042:0.en:
$$シベラ$$
「Incoming transmission from Captain $$マクシミリアン$$ of $$バトル７$$!」

683:t_042:1.en:
$$マックス$$
「Good news! The $$人類銀河同盟$$ has joined this battle too!」

683:t_042:3.en:
$$マックス$$
「With their cooperation, we are pulling the battle back to better than even on our end.」

683:t_042:4.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Also, a great swarm of $$バジュラ$$ is supporting us as well. You need not worry about us.」

683:t_042:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$バジュラ$$... So they understand us now.」

683:t_042:7.en:
$$マックス$$
「Also, the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ have been confirmed to be fighting the $$宇宙怪獣$$ on their own.」

683:t_042:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「There is no case in this unit's records of the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ conducting a joint operation with humanity.」

683:t_042:9.en:
$$レド$$
「It just means that data is outdated now.」

683:t_042:10.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「The various Spiral races of this universe, who were sealed away by the $$アンチスパイラル$$, are joining the war one after another as well.」

683:t_042:12.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「They are not the only ones fighting, you know.」

683:t_042:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$サルディアス$$! So you were alive!?」

683:t_042:14.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... I am embarrassed to say, yes.」

683:t_042:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But I have no intention of wasting the life I got back!」

683:t_042:17.en:
$$尸刻$$
「We reorganized the shattered $$サイデリアル$$, and they are taking part in the fighting against the $$バアル$$ on every front.」

683:t_042:19.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Now that we know Lady $$エルーナ$$'s true intentions, there is no longer any need to hold back against those who ruled the $$サイデリアル$$.」

683:t_042:20.en:
$$尸刻$$
「We will fight in order to live, too.」

683:t_042:21.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That is how it is, yes.」

683:t_042:22.en:
$$メール$$
「Honestly! You are such a smooth talker!」

683:t_042:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「OK! First we have to survive, or there is nothing to talk about!」

683:t_042:24.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Reaching each other's hearts, and living together...」

683:t_042:25.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The condition for $$シンカ$$... So that is the truth.」

683:t_042:26.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Are you watching, $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$!? People can connect with each other even without using methods like yours!)

683:t_042:27.en:
$$キリコ$$
(That is how it is, $$ワイズマン#pilot$$... You who tried to advance on your own probably cannot understand, though.)

683:t_042:28.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「But if the universe vanishes, everything is over.」

683:t_042:29.en:
$$甲児$$
「We will not let that happen!」

683:t_042:30.en:
$$アマタ$$
「As long as this $c is here!」

683:t_042:31.en:
$$刹那$$
「Right now, all the life in the universe is trying to become one in order to live!」

683:t_042:32.en:
$n
「If we bind that power together, we will not lose even to the force that seeks to vanish!」
